# Tooltip

A short description of a control, on hover and on focus.

- Status: implemented
- Category: container
- Pattern: WAI-ARIA APG “tooltip”; HTML `role=tooltip referenced by aria-describedby`
- Text style: `caption` (`.nd-text-caption`)

## Anatomy

- **bubble**: Inverse surface; does not cover its control.

## Variants

- `description`: Adds to the control's name.

## States

- `hidden`
- `shown`

## Keyboard

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Escape | Hides it without moving focus. |

## Accessibility

- Role: tooltip
- Never the only place of essential information; hoverable and persistent (1.4.13).
- Placement: shown as a popover (popover=hint or manual) in the top layer and linked by CSS anchor positioning (anchor-name on the control, position-anchor on the tooltip), it sits centred above the control and flips below near the top of the viewport.

WCAG 2.2 success criteria:

- 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) (AA)
- 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus (AA)
- 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value (A)

## Contrast

Each pair meets its ratio in every theme and direction (checked on every build).

| Foreground | Background | Minimum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `tooltip.text` | `tooltip.fill` | 4.5:1 |

## Web example

From the reference page:

```html
<span class="nd-cluster" style="position: relative">
  <button
    type="button"
    class="nd-button nd-button--quiet"
    aria-describedby="ex-tooltip"
  >
    Theme
  </button>
  <span
    class="nd-tooltip"
    role="tooltip"
    id="ex-tooltip"
    style="position: static"
    >Dark, light or high contrast</span
  >
</span>
```
